# NARWC fixture source list — template
#
# Format: source_fileid,description
#
# source_fileid  - FILEID as it appears in the production survey CSV filename
#                  (without .csv extension). Must not have 'T' in position 2
#                  (that would indicate an already-anonymized fixture).
# description    - Optional free-text note about the survey (for reference only).
#
# Lines starting with '#' are ignored. Blank lines are ignored.
# Single-column lines (just source_fileid, no comma) are also accepted.
#
# The test FILEID is computed automatically — you do NOT supply it.
# Convention: pos 1 preserved | pos 2 = 'T' | pos 3-4 = YY | pos 5-7 = DDD | pos 8 preserved.
# Dates (YY/DDD) are derived from the first valid data row after the date shift.
#
# Run with:
#   anonymize_surveys('/path/to/source/surveys', ...
#                     'tests/fixtures/source_list.txt', ...
#                     '../narwc_fixtures_manifest.txt')
#
# The manifest path MUST be outside the repository. The recommended location
# is one directory above the repo root: ../narwc_fixtures_manifest.txt
#
# Example entries (uncomment and edit):
#
# a111282,Aerial survey 2011 day 282 — Gulf of Maine
# f000007,Ship survey
# o001033,Opportunistic sightings batch
# H066139,Historical survey
